dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "What? You're saying you've been trapped on this island for... for generations!?"

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Trapped or not, this is the only life we know. We can't leave..."

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Good god... So are we... stuck here now, too?"
